FAQs

Plastering Questions, Answered

What people ask before they ring, answered by Darren.

Plastering and Skimming Venetian Plaster and Microcement About Us

Plastering and Skimming

How long after plastering can I paint?

Once it is dry, at room temperature normally 2 to 3 days. More on plastering and skimming.

How long does it take to skim a room?

It depends on the job. A kitchen of about 3 by 4 metres can usually be skimmed in a day, maybe a day and a half.

How long does a media wall take to plaster?

Media walls can be challenging because of the detail, so most take 1 to 2 days. A media wall in an office in Hamilton took 1 day. See media walls.

What plaster do you use?

Gypsum brand materials, and always have. Darren reckons they are more or less the best plastering materials you can buy, as they are tried and tested by a lot of tradesmen.

Can you plaster the walls after a rewire?

Yes. Chases and holes left by a rewire or a new kitchen are plastered back ready to decorate, from an emergency call out after a rewire to a kitchen rewire in Edinburgh as part of a Wren kitchen install. Jo mentions it in her review.

Venetian Plaster and Microcement

Can microcement be installed in a bathroom?

Yes. Microcement is a completely seamless and waterproof system, so it works in bathrooms and wet rooms. See microcement.

Can microcement go over tiles?

Yes, as long as none of the tiles are loose and the background is solid.

Where else can microcement be used?

Floors, for a seamless look, as well as walls, bathrooms and wet rooms. It can also go over worktops, furniture and many other materials, and it comes in a great range of colours, with bespoke colours matched.

What Venetian plaster styles can you do?

There are many Venetian styles for feature walls, from marble effects to pitted, stone like finishes. A recent one was a grey marble vein finish on a stairwell wall. See Venetian plaster.

How long do Venetian plaster and microcement take?

Longer than skimming. In a room the size of a 3 by 4 metre kitchen it could take up to a week, maybe quicker depending on the finish.

Where did you train in Venetian plaster and microcement?

Venetian plaster with Venezia Stucco in Essex, who also supply the materials, and microcement with Luna Plaster in Coventry. DRN is an approved installer for Venezia Stucco and Luna Plaster.
